video.title: AI欧腐《穿成龙太子的恶毒王夫/I Woke Up as the Dragon Prince's Evil Consort》
video.desc:
Rowan drowns saving a girl and wakes inside the body of a snow leopard prince in a dragon-ruled empire, married to Crown Prince Cassian and father to an eight-year-old daughter he never knew. Instead of the original Rowan’s cruelty, he chooses kindness, and slowly the child, the palace and Cassian begin to believe he has really changed.
Rowan 为救一个女孩溺水身亡，醒来却进入了一头雪豹王子的身体——在一个龙族统治的帝国里，他是太子 Cassian 的配偶，还是一个素未谋面的八岁女儿的父亲。
他没有延续原主的残忍，而是选择了善良。渐渐地，女儿、整个王宫，乃至 Cassian 本人，都开始相信：他真的变了。
